definitions.text_mt: Il-parti ta' gewwa tal-għonq li tgħaqqad il-ħalq mal-istonku u li minnha jgħaddu l-ikel u l-arja.

usage_examples.text_mt: Qala' biċċa laħam fil-gerżuma u bata jibilgħu.
usage_examples.text_en: He got a piece of meat stuck in his throat and struggled to swallow it.

usage_examples.text_mt: Il-gerżuma tweġġgħni meta nibilgħu.
usage_examples.text_en: My throat hurts when I swallow.

definitions.text_mt: Ġabar jew akkumula fi munzell jew borġ.

usage_examples.text_mt: Geżżeż il-ġebel kollu fil-ġenb tar-raba.
usage_examples.text_en: He heaped up all the stones at the edge of the field.

definitions.text_mt: Tkellem b'leħen baxx u mhux ċar b'mod li ma jinstemax tajjeb.
Imtela jew inġabar f'massa kbira ta' nies jew annimali.

usage_examples.text_mt: X'qed tgħid? Tkellem aktar ċar, għax qed tgħaġweġ.
usage_examples.text_en: What are you saying? Speak more clearly, because you're mumbling.

usage_examples.text_mt: In-nies bdew jgħaġwġu madwar is-saqqafa.
usage_examples.text_en: People began to swarm around the bandstand.

definitions.text_mt: Grupp kbir u miġbur ta' nies jew annimali.
Nuqqas ta' ordni, stat ta' konfużjoni jew taħwid.

usage_examples.text_mt: Kien hemm ġeġwiġija kbira fis-suq il-Ħadd.
usage_examples.text_en: There was a huge crowd at the market on Sunday.

usage_examples.text_mt: Wara l-aħbar, inħolqot ġeġwiġija fost il-folla.
usage_examples.text_en: After the news, a state of confusion broke out among the crowd.

definitions.text_mt: Kebbeb jew għatta b'karta, drapp, jew materjal ieħor.

usage_examples.text_mt: Ġeżwert ir-rigal f'karta sabiħa ħamra.
usage_examples.text_en: I wrapped the gift in beautiful red paper.

usage_examples.text_mt: Jgħażwru l-ħwejjeġ qabel ma jpoġġuhom fil-valiġġa.
usage_examples.text_en: They wrap the clothes before putting them in the suitcase.

definitions.text_mt: Qarraq b'xi ħadd bil-għan li tieħu vantaġġ jew tibbenefika.

usage_examples.text_mt: Għabbuni meta xtrajt l-antik mill-ħanut.
usage_examples.text_en: They cheated me when I bought the antique from the shop.

usage_examples.text_mt: Jigġabba lin-nies biex jieħu flushom.
usage_examples.text_en: He cheats people to take their money.

definitions.text_mt: Tgħawweġ jew tilef is-saħħa minħabba x-xjuħija u t-tkabbir fl-età.

usage_examples.text_mt: In-nannu beda jiggaffa maż-żmien u issa jimxi mgħawweġ.
usage_examples.text_en: Grandfather began to stoop with time and now walks hunched over.

definitions.text_en: to list (to tilt to one side)
definitions.text_mt: Jmejjel jew inklin lejn naħa waħda għal bastiment jew vettura.

usage_examples.text_mt: Il-bastiment beda jiggalluna minħabba l-maltemp.
usage_examples.text_en: The ship began to list because of the storm.

definitions.text_mt: Kisi ta' metall bil-żingu permezz ta' kurrent elettriku sabiex ma jissaddadx.

usage_examples.text_mt: Ggalvanizzaw il-ħadid tal-knisja biex idum aktar.
usage_examples.text_en: They galvanised the church's ironwork to make it last longer.

definitions.text_mt: Għaqqad ma' oħrajn biex topponi jew tattakka lil xi ħadd.

usage_examples.text_mt: Tfal tal-iskola ggangew kontra l-ġdid biex ibeżżgħuh.
usage_examples.text_en: Schoolchildren ganged up on the new kid to scare him.

definitions.text_mt: Qabad, dendel, jew waħħal permezz ta' ganċ.

usage_examples.text_mt: Ġġanċja x-xibka mal-ħajt biex tinxef.
usage_examples.text_en: He hooked the net onto the wall to dry.

definitions.text_en: to guarantee, to warrant, to ensure, to assure
definitions.text_mt: Wiegħed b'mod formali li xi ħaġa se sseħħ jew hija vera.

usage_examples.text_mt: Ggarantili li l-karozza kienet f'kundizzjoni tajba.
usage_examples.text_en: He guaranteed me that the car was in good condition.

definitions.text_en: to guarantee, to warrant, to ensure, to assure
definitions.text_mt: Wiegħed b'mod formali li xi ħaġa se sseħħ jew hija vera.

usage_examples.text_mt: Il-kumpanija ggarantixxiet il-prodott għal sentejn.
usage_examples.text_en: The company guaranteed the product for two years.

usage_examples.text_mt: Jiggarantixxi li x-xogħol isir sal-ġimgħa d-dieħla.
usage_examples.text_en: He guarantees that the work will be done by next week.

definitions.text_mt: Laħlaħ il-ħalq jew il-gerżuma billi ċċaqlaq likwidu warajh mingħajr ma tibla'.

usage_examples.text_mt: Ggargarizza bl-ilma mielaħ meta tweġġgħu l-gerżuma.
usage_examples.text_en: Gargle with salt water when your throat hurts.

definitions.text_en: to feather, to join by a tongue and groove
definitions.text_mt: Għaqqad biċċiet ta' injam permezz ta' lsien u skanalatura biex jibqgħu mwaħħlin.

usage_examples.text_mt: L-armar skartat għaqqdu flimkien permezz ta' lsien u skanalatura.
usage_examples.text_en: The discarded lumber was joined together by a tongue and groove.

definitions.text_mt: Espona għal gass jew ikkura b'gass għal skop mediku.

usage_examples.text_mt: Ggassjaw is-serra biex iżommu l-pjanti sħan.
usage_examples.text_en: They gassed the greenhouse to keep the plants warm.

definitions.text_mt: Kebbeb, waħħal, jew għatta bil-gomma.

usage_examples.text_mt: Ġġomma l-envelop u bagħtu bil-posta.
usage_examples.text_en: He gummed the envelope and sent it by post.

definitions.text_en: to govern, to rule by law
definitions.text_mt: Mexxa jew tmexxi skont il-liġi u l-awtorità.
Ta ordnijiet b'mod awtoritarju.

usage_examples.text_mt: Il-Prim Ministru ggverna l-pajjiż għal ħames snin.
usage_examples.text_en: The Prime Minister governed the country for five years.

usage_examples.text_mt: Jigġverna lill-impjegati b'idu tal-ħadid.
usage_examples.text_en: He rules the employees with an iron fist.

definitions.text_mt: L-att tat-tmexxija jew l-amministrazzjoni ta' stat jew organizzazzjoni.

usage_examples.text_mt: L-istudenti tgħallmu dwar l-istorja tal-gvernar f'Malta.
usage_examples.text_en: The students learnt about the history of governing in Malta.

definitions.text_mt: Ġġieled jew ipparteċipa f'kunflitt armat bejn stati jew gruppi.

usage_examples.text_mt: Iż-żewġ pajjiżi bdew jiggwerraw fuq il-fruntiera.
usage_examples.text_en: The two countries started warring over the border.

definitions.text_en: to accuse or tell that something is false
definitions.text_mt: Qal lil xi ħadd li dak li qal huwa falz jew mhux minnu.

usage_examples.text_mt: Giddeb lix-xhud quddiem il-qorti.
usage_examples.text_en: He accused the witness of lying before the court.

definitions.text_mt: Persuna li tgħid il-gideb b'mod intenzjonat u regolari.

usage_examples.text_mt: M'għandekx temmen kelmtu għax hu giddieb magħruf.
usage_examples.text_en: You should not believe his word because he is a known liar.

usage_examples.text_mt: Giddieba huma dawk li dejjem jgħidu dak li mhux veru.
usage_examples.text_en: Liars are those who always say what is not true.

definitions.text_mt: Persuna jew annimal li jigdem.
Min jitkellem ħażin dwar ħaddieħor fl-assenza tiegħu.

usage_examples.text_mt: Il-kelb kien giddiem u kellu jżommuh marbut.
usage_examples.text_en: The dog was a biter and they had to keep it tied up.

usage_examples.text_mt: Twarrab minnu għax hu giddiem u jħobb ixerred qlajja.
usage_examples.text_en: Stay away from him because he is a backbiter who loves to spread gossip.

definitions.text_en: verbal noun of gideb: the act of lying that which is untrue, lies
definitions.text_mt: Dikjarazzjoni intenzjonata li mhix vera.

usage_examples.text_mt: Il-gideb qatt ma jwassal għall-ġid.
usage_examples.text_en: Lying never leads to good.

definitions.text_mt: Qal intenzjonalment dak li mhux veru bil-għan li iqarraq.

usage_examples.text_mt: Gideb lil ommu meta qalilha li kien mar jistudja.
usage_examples.text_en: He lied to his mother when he told her he had gone to study.

usage_examples.text_mt: Jigdeb kuljum biex jevita l-problemi.
usage_examples.text_en: He lies every day to avoid trouble.
